subject: Web Development
title: The Mosaic Browser Moment
description: A 60-second lesson on The Mosaic Browser Moment.

hook.text: Before 1993, the web was text-only. Then a student in Illinois changed everything.

buildup.text: Marc Andreessen built Mosaic, the first browser to show images inline with text.

discovery.text: Suddenly the web was visual. People could see photos, logos, and graphics on a page.

twist.text: Academics mocked it as dumbing down the internet. They preferred text-only Gopher.

climax.text: Within a year, web traffic grew 341,000%. Mosaic made the web a mass medium.

punchline.text: One browser turned the web from text to visual.

quiz.question: What did Mosaic introduce to web browsing?
